content: next-sanity 13.3.1 is current stable. Requires next ^16, react ^19.2.3, sanity ^5.29.0 || ^6.0.0, @sanity/client ^7.26.1. Client setup: createClient({projectId, dataset, apiVersion:'2026-02-01', useCdn:true, stega:{studioUrl}}). defineLive() exports sanityFetch and SanityLive component for live preview + Draft Mode. defineQuery() wraps GROQ strings for type safety. Visual editing via VisualEditing component + Draft Mode API route. @sanity/image-url 2.1.1 for image transforms.
